runners.name: Jet To Glory

races.race_name: Young Guns Handicap

runners.name: Jack Rabbit Slims
runners.spotlight: Maiden after 12 starts but he has gone close in two C&D handicaps (good to firm) this year and to his credit that he nearly got back up three weeks ago, in this headgear combination; in the thick of it.
runners.comment: 0-12 but involved in two close calls over C&D, only just failed to get back up latest

runners.name: What A Tahoo
runners.spotlight: Has found her level in 5f handicaps of late, getting off the mark in quite taking style at Ripon (good; chief victim has won since) before having a troubled run at Musselburgh recently; also has form on a stiff track and should be able to plunder something else off her current mark.
runners.comment: In good form, ready winner at Ripon (5f) before troubled run latest; can find another race
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

runners.name: Sparkling Wine
runners.spotlight: Improved form when second on handicap debut at Catterick but she played up before the start of a C&D race since (joint-favourite; Jack Rabbit Slims second) and failed to come up with much; now has something to prove.
runners.comment: Played up before start over C&D latest and found little; now has something to find

runners.name: Dabbling
runners.spotlight: Opening mark suffered from one good run as 2yo and although she's dropped a few pounds this year she didn't find as much as the second Jack Rabbit Slims and third Power Of Chora over C&D recently; shade more needed.
runners.comment: Dropped a few pounds since handicapping; fair 4th over C&D latest; shade more needed

runners.name: Our Hero Matty
runners.spotlight: Failed to progress as a 2yo and was well held in sprint handicaps on the AW and turf for previous yard; however, he shaped nicely on his debut for this one when third at Catterick (6f, good to firm) in June so now he's of more interest again.
runners.comment: Became rather downbeat for previous yard but encouraging debut for this one in June (6f)

runners.name: Power Of Chora
runners.spotlight: Fairly routine form in her first handicaps but she is more favourably treated now and the drop to 5f seemed to suit when coming from off the pace to finish close up behind Jack Rabbit Slims over C&D (good to firm; in this headgear combination); can take a hand again.
runners.comment: Shaped better when dropped to 5f and close up over C&D latest; can take a hand again

runners.name: Roy Lane
runners.spotlight: Two siblings won Listed and Group 2 sprints; clear evidence of ability at York (5f, good to firm) last May, behind rivals who are way above this bracket; off for 11 months after and he didn't show much on his return at Doncaster in April but his AW run since (first-time cheekpieces, retained) was better; no surprise if he goes well on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Good sprint pedigree; promising debut as 2yo; can do better now handicapping
runners.owner: Mrs Polly Gibson & Miss Pollyanne Gibson

runners.name: Country Artiste
runners.spotlight: Early promise for previous yard but didn't progress and it's been a struggle off high marks since switched to handicaps; dropping steadily in the weights and down in grade so may do better; has worn a hood, first-time cheekpieces today.
runners.comment: Early promise but didn't go on; handicaps have been a struggle but now down in grade

races.race_name: Malcolm Greenslade Doncaster LVA Stalwart Memorial Handicap

runners.name: Pendella
runners.spotlight: AW maiden winner in February (8.5f); placed in decent handicaps at York (1m2f, good) and Epsom (1m2f, soft) on last two starts; has made the running; chance now down in grade.
runners.comment: AW maiden winner (8.5f); sound placed efforts in 1m2f handicaps on last two starts; chance

runners.name: Tamzan
runners.spotlight: Off the mark in an 8.5f maiden here last time (good; third has won since); weakened when tried over 9.5f on AW as a 2yo but may yet improve over this sort of trip (dam won over 1m2f).
runners.comment: Won 8.5f maiden here last time and may improve again for this step up in trip

runners.name: Mandarin Spirit
runners.spotlight: Won a 7f Thirsk maiden last July (good); hasn't progressed since going handicapping and was beaten nearly 5l over 1m at Thirsk last time (good); may improve at 1m2f.
runners.comment: 7f Thirsk maiden winner last July; hasn't progressed in handicaps this term; new trip

runners.name: It's Debatable
runners.spotlight: Best of his three runs when neck second to a useful prospect at Hamilton last time (1m1f, good to firm); interesting on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Neck second to a useful sort in Hamilton maiden last time; interesting on h'cap debut

races.race_name: Beverley Annual Badgeholders Handicap

runners.name: Kitsune Power
runners.spotlight: Hasn't won for more than two years, but sound effort when length second over C&D in May (good to firm); each-way chance.
runners.comment: Not won since June 2024; sound run when second over C&D in May; each-way chance

runners.name: Dr Rio
runners.spotlight: Has won six races here, from 7.5f to 1m4f, the latest last August (1m4f, good to firm); creditable third here in May (8.5f, good) but below-par last two runs; could go well.
runners.comment: Six-time course winner (7.5f-1m4f); not at his best last twice; fast ground suits; chance

runners.name: Star Start
runners.spotlight: Two wins last season, the first a dead-heat over C&D in July (good to firm); rather patchy form this season, best run when third at Pontefract in April (1m, good); a possible on second run back after wind op.
runners.comment: Two wins last term, the first a C&D dead-heat; not so good in 2026; 2nd run after wind op

runners.name: Bradbury
runners.spotlight: Progressive 3yo; has done well since tried in an eyeshield with wins over this trip at Leicester (good) and Wetherby (good to firm); 4lb higher; one to consider.
runners.comment: Progressive 3yo; two wins at this trip since tried in an eyeshield; up 4lb; contender

runners.name: Wicklow Way
runners.spotlight: Won over 1m2f at Newcastle in March, and creditable third over 8.5f here last time (good); each-way chance
runners.comment: 1m2f AW winner in March; best run since when third here last time (8.5f); each-way chance

runners.name: Melting Snow
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo; ordinary form over 7f; likely to improve significantly up in trip (dam a Group-placed 1m2f winner) and should go well on handicap debut.
runners.comment: Unexposed 3yo; ordinary form over 7f; should improve now up in trip on handicap debut

runners.name: Mavetheforcebewivu
runners.spotlight: 18-race maiden; second over 8.5f here last month, but most of her form this term is fairly ordinary; others appeal more.
runners.comment: 0-18; creditable second here last month, but other form this season is ordinary

runners.name: Lever Up
runners.spotlight: 12-race maiden; creditable third to a pair of subsequent winners at Carlisle last time (1m1f, good); conditions suit; should go well.
runners.comment: 0-12; good third to two subsequent winners at Carlisle last time; should go well again

runners.name: Sunny Orange
runners.spotlight: Four-time course winner at up to 8.5f, latest success being in April (8.5f, good to firm); fair form since including when 2l fourth here last time (7.5f, good to firm); tries this trip for first time.
runners.comment: Four-time course winner; good fourth here last time (7.5f); tries this trip for first time

races.race_name: Connexin Gigabit Gallop Handicap

runners.name: Barmyblade
runners.spotlight: Four wins over 5f/6f last season; back to winning ways at Thirsk last time (6f, good to firm; cheekpieces back on); not ideally drawn but a contender off 4lb higher.
runners.comment: Four wins last season (5f/6f) and back to winning ways at Thirsk last time; up 4lb; chance

runners.name: He's An Angel
runners.spotlight: Has won six times on the AW, but 0-15 on turf; creditable second at Wetherby two runs back (5.5f, good to firm) but well beaten last time (6f).
runners.comment: Six AW wins but 0-15 on turf; good second at Wetherby two runs back; not so good last time

runners.name: Pinpoint
runners.spotlight: Ex-Ewan Whillans; sound run on stable debut when second at Wetherby last time (5.5f, good to firm); each-way chance.
runners.comment: Ex Ewan Whillans; sound run on stable debut when second at Wetherby; each-way chance

runners.name: Crafty Spirit
runners.spotlight: Has run two good races this season, last time getting off the mark on turf at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm); each-way chance.
runners.comment: Two good runs this season, winning first turf race at Wetherby last time; each-way chance

runners.name: Ziva's Star
runners.spotlight: 22-race maiden; third in a Leicester classified two runs ago (cheekpieces on first time) but well beaten last time.
runners.comment: 0-22; third in a classified two runs ago but well beaten last time

runners.name: Golden Prosperity
runners.spotlight: 3lb lower than when winning at Catterick in April (5f, good); mainly disappointing since, although was only 2l behind Barmyblade (5lb worse off) when third at Thirsk last time (6f, good to firm); well drawn and a possible.
runners.comment: 3lb lower than Catterick win in April; good third to Barmyblade last time; chance

runners.name: Invincible Annice
runners.spotlight: Winner at Newcastle last November, but disappointing since; blinkers now tried (well beaten in a visor last time); plenty to prove at present.
runners.comment: AW winner last November; disappointing since; blinkers now tried; plenty to prove

runners.name: Without Flaw
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner last season (soft/good to firm); not been in quite such good form this time, but is on a good mark as a result; wide draw not ideal.
runners.comment: Dual C&D winner in 2025; not in such good form this term; on a good mark but badly drawn

runners.name: Opal Storm
runners.spotlight: 5f Southwell winner in April, but last of 12 at Hamilton on latest start (5f, good); bit to prove.
runners.comment: Southwell winner in April, but ordinary efforts on turf since (last of 12 last time).

runners.name: So Grateful
runners.spotlight: 2-39 on turf, but creditable fourth at Ayr last week (6f, good); worth considering.
runners.comment: 2-39 on turf; creditable fourth at Ayr last week (6f); worth considering

races.race_name: Racing Again On Monday Evening Handicap

runners.name: Thornaby Annie
runners.spotlight: Good run of form in May and June once hooded, finishing runner-up in two 7f handicaps before getting off the mark at Wetherby (1m, good to firm); ran out of steam after failing to settle at Nottingham (about 1m) 12 days ago but this test, in a less competitive race, should suit better.
runners.comment: Good run of form included 1m win; ran out of steam latest but this looks more suitable

runners.name: The Sweet Escape
runners.spotlight: Tough type who has been on the go since last December, winning at Nottingham and just touched off at Leicester (both at about 1m), but seemingly suited by the shortest trip he's tackled this year when making all over C&D 11 days ago; back up 3lb; can go well again.
runners.comment: Tough type; better than ever when making all over C&D latest; back up 3lb; can go well

runners.name: Viviana
runners.spotlight: Unraced as 2yo; useful start when a close third of six at Redcar (6f) in April but less convincing since and her effort petered out when upped to 7f at Musselburgh on handicap debut; still early days but work to do for now.
runners.comment: Promising debut over 6f in April but less convincing since, including on handicap debut

runners.name: Solar Cooper
runners.spotlight: Faded over C&D on his yard debut following a break and has been kept to 6f since, improving for the fitting of cheekpieces when winning at Ripon (good) in May; in nothing like the same form in two starts since, though.
runners.comment: Well held since 6f win in May; hard to count on revival back over C&D

runners.name: Enjoy The Night
runners.spotlight: All races at 5f and he hasn't achieved much in either handicap, for previous yard and this one; some encouragement in pedigree for a step up in trip but probably best watched even so.
runners.comment: All races at 5f; well held in two handicaps, the latest for new yard; big step up in trip

runners.name: Secretinthesky
runners.spotlight: Well held in two AW runs, including on handicap debut at Newcastle (7f) 19 days ago but she had run quite promisingly, despite being beaten about 7l, on her reappearance at Thirsk last month and ought to have some potential in ordinary handicaps.
runners.comment: Well held on handicap debut (AW) but some promise on return and return to turf could suit
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd & Julie Camacho

runners.name: Dumfries
runners.spotlight: Three wins in 2025 included two over C&D (good to firm); this is a belated return by his standards but he has won after a break and would be very competitive if reasonably straight for his comeback.
runners.comment: Three wins in 2025 included two over C&D; would be very competitive if straight on return
runners.owner: Buist, Shields, Thompson And Mrs R Carr

runners.name: Shahik
runners.spotlight: Won 6f maiden on Newcastle AW as 2yo for previous yard but has found it a mighty struggle since, without and with headgear (first-time visor today); has much to prove over this stiff test and needs more weight off back.
runners.comment: Won 6f AW maiden as 2yo; a mighty struggle since; trip  query; needs more weight off back

races.race_name: Best Ticket Deals Online leicester-racecourse.co.uk Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Tiger In The Tree
runners.spotlight: Twice showed a bit of ability from her four starts, notably on latest when keeping on from the back to be about 2l third of five to Emerald Bay on nursery debut at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm); dropped just 1lb but 5lb claimer and cheekpieces are enlisted; not entirely dismissed.
runners.comment: Kept on from the back when 3rd of five to Emerald Bay at Beverley (7.4f); cheekpieces now

runners.name: Emerald Bay
runners.spotlight: Upped markedly in trip with cheekpieces added for nursery debut at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm) ten days ago and justified 11-10 favouritism in five-runner race by leading on the post; Tiger In The Tree nearly 2l back in third; up 3lb and bare 7f may be on the short side but this should be a weak field.
runners.comment: 11-10 in five-runner race when leading on post in nursery at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm)

runners.name: Le Grand Etoile
runners.spotlight: Last on his first two starts (6f; bit slipped on first occasion) but beating one home in a six-runner maiden at Hamilton (5f, good to soft; 50-1) four weeks ago was a first sign of significant ability; gelded since and makes nursery debut over 7f, which looks much more the ticket on pedigree.
runners.comment: Gelded now and makes nursery debut over 7f, which looks much more the ticket on pedigree

runners.name: Aura Of Melania
runners.spotlight: Closest finish at Wetherby (7f, good to firm; helped to set pace) on second start, before fourth again when 25-1 again on Newcastle AW (7f); greater market interest might signal she has a chance on this nursery debut.
runners.comment: Greater market interest might signal she has a chance on this nursery debut

runners.name: Postcard
runners.spotlight: Tongue tied for nursery debut at Chepstow (6f, good to firm; 12-1) on latest start and it was her closest finish, albeit beaten about 6l in last of seven under Olivia Tubb; blinkered this time; others have more substantial claims.
runners.comment: Closest finish on nursery debut at Chepstow (6f), albeit beaten about 6l in last of seven

runners.name: Alpaca's Bullet
runners.spotlight: Late foal who's been never dangerous in her three starts, all over 5f; dam was a 2yo 7f winner (RPR 84) and this daughter could be much more interesting now trying that trip on nursery debut; worth a market check.
runners.comment: Could be much more interesting upped from 5f for this nursery debut; worth a market check

runners.name: Hamdani Mokhater
runners.spotlight: Finished a bit closer in each of his three runs, albeit still beaten about 7l when fifth of nine in C&D maiden (good; prominent long way at 66-1) last time; gelded soon afterwards and now wears cheekpieces; needs improvement on this handicap debut.
runners.comment: Now gelded and wears cheekpieces; needs improvement on this handicap debut

runners.name: Bluestone Lady
runners.spotlight: Six races, runner-up in her only two on AW; improved efforts when blinkered by new yard for last two starts, close second in a maiden at Newcastle latest on the step up to 7f; needs better again on this nursery debut.
runners.comment: Six races and runner-up twice, including in a 7f AW maiden last time; makes nursery debut

runners.name: Magical Life
runners.spotlight: Best when fifth of eight at 100-1 for nursery debut at Kempton (upped from 5f to 7f, AW) 12 days ago, having hung badly left turning for home; cheekpieces (worn on penultimate start) return; another 5lb claimer takes over; capable of better if keeping far more of a straight line.
runners.comment: Fifth of eight at 100-1 for nursery debut at Kempton (7f, AW) when she hung badly left

runners.name: Agnes Hathaway
runners.spotlight: Low-level form on all four starts, 33-1 for latest on her nursery debut on Kempton AW (7f, AW); needs to show something very new.
runners.comment: Low-level form on all four starts, 33-1 for latest on nursery debut on Kempton AW (7f, AW)
runners.owner: D Kilburn, C Wright, F Mahony & Partner

races.race_name: British EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Siwa Oasis
runners.spotlight: Fair form when second at Kempton (7f, AW) last October and when beaten just under 6l at Newbury (1m/1m2f, good) on both starts this season; big player.
runners.comment: Fair form on all three starts, this season's at Newbury (1m/1m2f, good); big player

runners.name: Kudos Too
runners.spotlight: 50-1 for maiden at Sandown (1m2f, good) one month ago and slowly away but he made a big move in the penultimate furlong before running out of steam late on, beaten 3l in fifth of six; likely to prove a good deal better and, although stamina is questionable on pedigree, he's one to take seriously.
runners.comment: 50-1 at Sandown (1m2f, good) when making an eye-catching debut; one to take seriously
runners.owner: Mrs R F Greener And North Farm Stud

runners.name: White Storm
runners.spotlight: 11l second to the subsequent Royal Ascot flop Water To Wine in novice at Kempton (1m3f, AW) on debut in May; weak 11-1 at Doncaster (1m4f, good to soft) 18 days later, however, and readily left behind from over 1f out to finish a well-beaten last of five; mixed messages.
runners.comment: Mixed messages from novice events at Kempton (1m3f, AW; 2nd) and Doncaster (1m4f; last)

runners.name: Amazonica
runners.spotlight: 62,000euros yearling, 110,000euros breeze-up 2yo; tenth foal; Ghaiyyath half-brother to winners Sir Andrew (7f-1m1f including HK Group 1; RPR 126), Katara (Spanish 1m) and Alejandria (Spanish 7f-1m2f); dam Italian 7f/1m3f winner, out of 7.7f 2yo winner; late foal; the market can guide on debut.
runners.comment: 110,000euros breeze-up 2yo; Ghaiyyath half-brother to 7f-1m1f winner Sir Andrew (RPR 126)

runners.name: Knight Of Storms
runners.spotlight: Slowly away when beaten more than 20l in good-ground maidens at Newbury (1m2f) and Pontefract (1m4f) so he has no form claims.
runners.comment: Beaten more than 20l in good-ground maidens at Newbury (1m2f) and Pontefract (1m4f)

runners.name: Cloud Forest
runners.spotlight: 11-2 when making his belated debut in novice at Nottingham (1m2f, good to soft) in May, close up 1m before finishing sixth of ten; trainer won this race in 2018, 2020 and 2021; could be a big improver.
runners.comment: 11-2 when sixth of ten at Nottingham (1m2f, good to soft) in May; could be big improver

races.race_name: Nelson Restaurant For Classic Raceday Dining Handicap

runners.name: Betelgeuse
runners.spotlight: One win from 14 races; three seconds from five starts this year, beaten a head at Newmarket (2m, good to firm; made most) 18 days ago in first-time cheekpieces; they are now replaced by blinkers; last time he raced over shorter than 1m6f was in June 2025 but this isn't a strong race; good chance.
runners.comment: Three seconds this year; the last time he raced over shorter than 1m6f was in June 2025

runners.name: Trojan Truth
runners.spotlight: Bagged a hat-trick last summer, including his second C&D win; back to his last winning mark and second at Chepstow (1m4f, good to firm) suggested on penultimate start that he is almost as good as ever; big shout.
runners.comment: Chepstow second suggested on penultimate start that he is almost as good as ever

runners.name: Spec Of Light
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on stable debut at Southwell (1m3f, AW) in February but unable to get competitive since; latest start was a rare turf race and (poor form in this sphere) and overall score is 1-19.
runners.comment: Out of form; latest was a rare turf race (poor in this sphere) and overall score is 1-19

runners.name: Ottoman
runners.spotlight: Gained sole win here last June and beaten a neck over C&D late last month; front-running with first-time blinkers (retained today) at Carlisle five days ago did not work out but he needs a second look on return to Leicester.
runners.comment: Gained sole win here and beaten a neck over C&D late last month; below form five days ago

runners.name: Joanna Hiffernan
runners.spotlight: Beaten about 3l into fourth of five at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) on her second start but well beaten on starts either side; lacks solid achievements but this is her handicap debut, so early days.
runners.comment: Lacks solid achievements but this is her handicap debut, so early days

runners.name: Lenny's Spirit
runners.spotlight: Nine wins over the years, including two early last summer, but he's been going the wrong way this term; admittedly badly hampered on latest outing; 6lb below his last winning mark.
runners.comment: Nine wins over the years, with two early last summer, but he's been going the wrong way

races.race_name: Join Racing TV Today Handicap

runners.name: Dreambird Dolly
runners.spotlight: Wore this equipment combination on last three starts, beaten a nose in a Brighton handicap (5.2f, good to firm) on first occasion and making all in a classified here (5f, good) on second; wide draw and interference leaving the stalls prevented those tactics at Windsor three weeks ago; 5lb claimer is on board this time; should be of renewed interest.
runners.comment: So nearly won her first two runs with these aids; circumstances against her latest start
runners.owner: T Beeches, C Stone, J Gallagher

runners.name: Dottie Diamond
runners.spotlight: Off 19 months before this season; her second race back (seventh attempt overall) was her best when off the mark at 25-1 in a classified at Southwell (5f, AW) and in quite taking style too, so she needs a second look despite her handicap mark having been revised upwards in a major way.
runners.comment: Off the mark at 25-1 in a classified at Southwell (5f, AW) and in quite taking style too

runners.name: Rainbow Sorbet
runners.spotlight: Switched to handicaps when fourth of nine at Brighton (5.2f, good to firm) in May in a first-time visor; no show there (7f) last Tuesday and the visor is now removed; needs a marked overall step forward.
runners.comment: 4th of 9 on handicap debut at Brighton two runs back; needs a marked overall step forward

runners.name: Port Hedland
runners.spotlight: 2-30 overall, with the second win in a classified at Bath (5.7f, good) early last month; ran moderately under the same 7lb claimer at Brighton two weeks ago and may need his best run since last May.
runners.comment: 2-30 overall, with the second win in a classified at Bath (5.7f, good) early last month

runners.name: The Bear Of Saints
runners.spotlight: Two bits of modest form in his five races; last of 11 when 40-1 for last month's handicap debut (6f, soft) seemed to confirm that there are more solid options but, in fairness, it was his first race for 640 days.
runners.comment: Last of 11 when 40-1 for last month's handicap debut (6f, soft) on first race for 640 days

runners.name: Nzuri
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden after six starts (five for Jack Channon) but she was prominent for a long way under Rose Dawes when fourth of 12 at Newbury (good to firm) five days ago and that was clearly her best show from three handicaps; first attempt at 5f for this drop back in class might also offer some hope.
runners.comment: Latest start was clearly her best show from three handicaps; drops back in class

races.race_name: Evening Racing @leicesterraces Wednesday 22nd July Handicap

runners.name: Musical Soldier
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) in May and second in two of his last three starts; latest at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) six days ago was just a six-runner race but it looks like he will be bang there again.
runners.comment: Second of six at Chepstow (7f) six days ago and it looks like he will be bang there

runners.name: Lope Y Linda
runners.spotlight: Front-runner on last two outings; not proven on firmer than good after three attempts, two before she went handicapping and the other on reappearance; it's therefore possible to forgive those and, after two wins (7f) and two seconds from her last five starts, she needs major respect.
runners.comment: After two wins (7f) and two seconds from her last five starts, she needs major respect

runners.name: Arvana Belle
runners.spotlight: Made her mark in 6f/7f Brighton nurseries last season but she's hardly beaten a rival this term; blinkers go on.
runners.comment: Made her mark last season but she's hardly beaten a rival this term; blinkers go on

runners.name: Poetic Grace
runners.spotlight: Low-level maiden after seven races, which has still resulted in minor honours in three handicaps over 1m/7f before her form dipped over 6f on latest start; even best form needs improving on.
runners.comment: Minor honours in three handicaps over 1m/7f but even her best form needs improving on

runners.name: Auspicious
runners.spotlight: Ran poorly at Redcar on latest start but went into that in good form, including for a narrow Redcar win; all ten races have been 6f but he looks worth a go at 7f; one to consider even though he may need to bounce back with some improved form.
runners.comment: In good form before running poorly on latest start, all over 6f; looks worth a go at 7f

runners.name: Gal
runners.spotlight: Modest form in her three Irish races and no better in the two in Britain, although she has been more competitive with the switch to handicaps (5.7f/6f); needs to build on that with today's step back up in trip.
runners.comment: More competitive with the switch to handicaps (5.7f/6f); needs to build on that

races.race_name: Leicester Racecourse Ideal Conference Venue Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Melody De Vega
runners.spotlight: Fair maiden who has taken minor honours in two of her four handicaps, a rallying second of eight at Ripon (1m2f, good) on latest outing; unraced on firmer than good; firmly in the mix if she acts on it.
runners.comment: Minor honours in two of four handicaps; rallying 2nd of eight at Ripon (1m2f, good) latest
runners.owner: Michael P Tudor & J P M O'Connor

runners.name: Fille Imbassee
runners.spotlight: Switched to turf for last three starts and best of those when winning under Tom Kiely-Marshall over C&D (good to firm) on latest, albeit in a three-runner race; back up 3lb but considered seriously in another small field.
runners.comment: Back up 3lb after winning a three-runner C&D race but still considered in this small field

runners.name: Bergamo Gold
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row on AW in March and continued in good form on next two starts; considered on that form but beaten 20l on last two outings, on turf debut (1m2f, good) last time.
runners.comment: Considered on AW form; beaten 20l last two outings, on turf debut (1m2f, good) last time

runners.name: Imola
runners.spotlight: Has a 3-25 record on AW, including 9.4f wins this February and June; she's had only four races on turf and they were in 2024, showing some ability but not on a par with today's almost career-high mark.
runners.comment: 3-25 on AW, including 9.4f wins this February and June; her four turf races were in 2024

runners.name: Hot Silk
runners.spotlight: Similar form on all four starts, latest her handicap debut at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) when weakening into fourth of five; tries 1m2f for the first time and needs to find a bit extra.
runners.comment: Similar form all four starts; 4th of 5 on handicap debut at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm)

races.race_name: Private Boxes For Best View @leicesterraces Classified Stakes

runners.name: Bullington Bry
runners.spotlight: 0-21; latest of his three seconds was in February in first-time cheekpieces; slipped leaving the stalls on latest start; has since left Joey Ramsden; being visored first time didn't spark anything on penultimate outing but now it's the turn of blinkers and he has one of the better chances on ratings.
runners.comment: 0-21; left J Ramsden since latest start; first blinkers; one of the better rating chances

runners.name: Marisitta
runners.spotlight: 23-race maiden when she turned up for a handicap at Chepstow (6f, good to firm) 17 days ago but she won that seven-runner race, always prominent; that was a clear career best and it's striking that it was her first race at short of 6f; big player if the form is backed up.
runners.comment: 23-race maiden before a handicap at Chepstow (down to 6f) 17 days ago but she won it

runners.name: Rogue Rebellion
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 12 starts came at Lingfield (5f, AW) in January on penultimate outing for James Owen; comparable form in two of six turf races since for new yard and not totally disgraced on latest, so he's not entirely ruled out despite not being proven over quite this far.
runners.comment: Not entirely ruled out despite not being proven over quite this far

runners.name: Henry Tudor
runners.spotlight: Sole win (12 races) was in a 6f AW classified in February; switched to turf (good to firm) for his last two outings and needs to produce much better than those efforts.
runners.comment: Switched to turf (good to firm) for last two outings and needs to produce much better

runners.name: Sir Rodneyredblood
runners.spotlight: 9yo who has had 16 wins on AW, in January most recently; sole turf win (from 19 attempts) was at Yarmouth in 2022 but he came within a neck of another in a classified at same track (6f, good to firm) 18 days ago, which was the first time this year that he's worn his usual cheekpieces; has a shout if that form is repeated.
runners.comment: Sole turf win was at Yarmouth in 2022 but came within a neck of another there 18 days ago

runners.name: Gardening
runners.spotlight: Sole 2yo run was for Karl Burke; cut little ice that day or in her two recent outings; big drop in class and a visor is given a go, but no form claims.
runners.comment: Fourth start; big drop in class and a visor is given a go, but no form claims

runners.name: Saeculamation
runners.spotlight: Chelmsford (6f, AW) in December was his only win from 17 races; three minor honours on good ground this spring, before lesser shows on last two outings; place chance if back to form.
runners.comment: Three minor honours on good ground this spring, before lesser shows on last two outings

runners.name: Follow My Heart
runners.spotlight: Low-level form after six starts, which was nevertheless good enough for minor honours on good ground in two of her three handicaps (6f/5f) and the exception was on soft; unraced on firmer than good; best form running on over 5f on latest start and headgear is now enlisted; needs improvement but given a second look.
runners.comment: Best form running on over 5f last time and headgear is now enlisted; given a second look

runners.name: Drish Samphire
runners.spotlight: Low-level form in her six runs in Ireland for Donal Commins; off 17 months before well held in a 5f classified on AW last month; best watched.
runners.comment: Ex-Irish; off 17 months before well held in a 5f classified on AW last month

runners.name: Manhattan Chute
runners.spotlight: Sprung a 50-1 surprise in a handicap at Lingfield (5f, AW) in January, for his only win from 21 races, but right out of form since.
runners.comment: Lingfield (5f, AW) in January was his only win from 21 races; right out of form since
runners.owner: J May, R L Field, W Trenchard, J Pook

runners.name: Summer Rain
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden at his best in 2024 and 2025; not so good for new yard this year but latest start, when wearing first-time cheekpieces over 7f, was at least a step back in the right direction.
runners.comment: Not so good this year but latest start was at least a step back in the right direction

races.race_name: Dandara Homes EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Jaan Ki Tukri
runners.spotlight: Beaten four times but placed in his first three races and was beaten under 4l when ninth of 21 in the Coventry at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm); he'll be difficult to beat with a repeat of that fine effort; cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: He'll be difficult to beat with a repeat of his fine effort in the Coventry

runners.name: El Paso
runners.spotlight: 40,000euros yearling and 90,000gns breeze-up buy; brother to German 7f winner Elli Pirelli, closely related to German Group-placed 8.5f 2yo/1m1f winner El Loco (RPR 104); market support would heighten interest on debut.
runners.comment: 40,000euros yearling and 90,000gns breeze-up buy; brother to German 7f winner Elli Pirelli

runners.name: Sole Ambition
runners.spotlight: 150,000gns foal, 210,000gns yearling; by No Nay Never; second foal; dam Group-placed 6f winner (RPR 98), half-sister to useful 6f 2yo/7f winner Elinor Dashwood; has to be of interest.
runners.comment: 150,000gns foal, 210,000gns yearling; by No Nay Never; has to be of interest

runners.name: Louis The Fifth
runners.spotlight: 215,000euros breeze-up buy; showed ability when third in a four-runner field at Carlisle (5f, good to firm); he was the only colt against fillies that day; has to improve plenty if he's to trouble Jaan Ki Tukri.
runners.comment: Promising first run at Carlisle but has to improve plenty if he's to trouble Jaan Ki Tukri

runners.name: Le Ciel Noble
runners.spotlight: Has finished last in both his races and handicaps will be more like it.
runners.comment: Has finished last in both his races and handicaps will be more like it

races.race_name: Golwg Gwendraeth Nursery Handicap

runners.name: Tallahassee Lassie
runners.spotlight: First two runs were at Ascot and Goodwood; dropped back to 5f when third at Leicester last time (good to firm), running on well in the closing stages; should have a major say here on nursery debut.
runners.comment: First two runs were at Ascot and Goodwood; dropped back to 5f when third at Leicester

runners.name: Our Fella
runners.spotlight: His standout run is the close third at Windsor (5f, good to firm) and on that performance this mark looks realistic.
runners.comment: His standout run is the close third at Windsor; realistic mark on that effort

runners.name: Drum Major
runners.spotlight: Well down the field in all his races, in cheekpieces in final two starts; has to step up to defy this mark.
runners.comment: Well down the field in all his races, in cheekpieces in final two starts; has to step up

runners.name: Persian Sunset
runners.spotlight: Useful pedigree but no closer than 7l in three races over the minimum distance and this mark doesn't look obviously lenient, though Taryn Langley takes off a handy 5lb.
runners.comment: This mark doesn't look obviously lenient, though Taryn Langley takes off a handy 5lb

runners.name: Devon Angel
runners.spotlight: Hasn't shown a lot but handicapped accordingly and a tongue-tie now goes on; market helpful.
runners.comment: Hasn't shown a lot but handicapped accordingly and a tongue-tie now goes on

races.race_name: Diplomat Hotel Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Nevasca Cinza
runners.spotlight: Becoming exposed after six defeats and two of those were at odds-on, including the latest at Brighton; consistent though and won't be far away provided the new visor doesn't trip him up.
runners.comment: 0-6 but consistent and won't be far away provided the new visor doesn't trip him up

runners.name: Queen Sana
runners.spotlight: Had lots of chances now (0-10) and although she's regularly knocked on the door, there have been off days and Pontefract last time was one of those; others preferred.
runners.comment: Knocked on the door a few times; has off days and Pontefract last time was one of those

runners.name: Star Velocity
runners.spotlight: 80,000gns yearling; went off 28-1 at Southwell (6f AW) but saw her race out well to be third and back in fourth was last week's Newmarket handicap winner Planet Seeker; dropping back to 5f wouldn't be an obvious move, but she should have every chance with improvement surely on the cards.
runners.comment: Promising third on the AW and that form was boosted last week at Newmarket

runners.name: Livvys Edge
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to 5f AW/6f turf winner Outer Edge (RPR 67); dam 5f-6f winner (80); unlikely to provide the answer to this on her debut.
runners.comment: Half-sister to 5f AW/6f turf winner Outer Edge (RPR 67); dam 5f-6f winner (80)
runners.owner: Int Plywood (lmporters) Ltd And C Mason

runners.name: Kodicall
runners.spotlight: A belated debut for this gelding who is out of a 5f winner and sister to Listed-placed 7f/1m winner King's Field; likely best watched.
runners.comment: A belated debut for this gelding who is out of a 5f winner; likely best watched
runners.owner: Mrs Wendy Jarrett & J S Moore

runners.name: Gris De Chine
runners.spotlight: RPRs have regressed in each of her runs and she has no obvious form claims here; had wind surgery and now tongue tied.
runners.comment: RPRs have regressed in each of her runs and she has no obvious form claims here

runners.name: Far From Fern
runners.spotlight: Finished a remote fifth over 7f at Chepstow (good to firm) and limited appeal after that; drops back 2f.
runners.comment: Finished a remote fifth over 7f at Chepstow (good to firm) and limited appeal after that

races.race_name: Preventapest Handicap

runners.name: Tokyo Joe
runners.spotlight: 6f novice winner who is 0-4 in handicaps but was bang there in a Class 4 at York a month ago (7f, good) and has major claims with a repeat of that.
runners.comment: 0-4 in handicaps but he was bang there in a Class 4 at York a month ago

runners.name: Mayberry Moon
runners.spotlight: Both wins for Michael Dods were on ground softer than good; picked up for 1,000gns and ran quite well on his stable debut over C&D as he was quite fresh after a break; possibilities if building on that.
runners.comment: Ran quite well on his stable debut over C&D as he was quite fresh after a break

runners.name: Dandy G Boy
runners.spotlight: Two AW wins for this yard last year but has yet to look as effective on turf (0-6); well beaten on comeback at Lingfield (7f, good).
runners.comment: Two AW wins for this yard last year but has yet to look as effective on turf (0-6)

runners.name: Kaleidoscope Eyes
runners.spotlight: Has won on the AW and heavy ground (here); only fourth of eight here two weeks ago and that was a Class 6.
runners.comment: Only fourth of eight here two weeks ago and that was a Class 6

runners.name: Spirit Of The Bay
runners.spotlight: Exposed six-time winner who has performed moderately in her last two races over 1m; on the plus side, she hasn't had many chances at 7f over which she was a close fourth on her comeback.
runners.comment: Exposed six-time winner who has performed moderately in her last two races over 1m

runners.name: Freddie's Star
runners.spotlight: He was 1-16 when winning a weak novice at Chelmsford in November (7f, AW); hasn't kicked on from there and yet to get overly competitive in handicaps.
runners.comment: Novice winner; hasn't kicked on from there and yet to get overly competitive in handicaps

runners.name: Redredrobin
runners.spotlight: Eight-time winner who has slipped to a good mark but last season didn't end well and this campaign has yet to get going; a 9yo now.
runners.comment: Last season didn't end well and this campaign has yet to get going; a 9yo now

runners.name: Counting Cards
runners.spotlight: No wins in eight; had placed form for Edward Bethell but signed off for that yard under a cloud; would have claims if he can turn a corner for new yard.
runners.comment: Had placed form for Edward Bethell but signed off for that yard under a cloud

runners.name: Follow Your Heart
runners.spotlight: Both turf wins have come at Doncaster where he beat only one home last time out (7f, good); that was his fourth disappointing run in succession.
runners.comment: Both turf wins have come at Doncaster where he beat only one home last time out

races.race_name: Dandara, Beautiful New Homes In Carway "Confined" Handicap (Not Won A Flat Race In 2026)

runners.name: Racing Demon
runners.spotlight: Keeps missing the break but he still went close two starts ago at Chepstow and it wasn't a bad run here last time, again over 1m; returning to further looks a good move.
runners.comment: Keeps running well despite slow starts and returning to further looks a good move

runners.name: Havana Tobouggaloo
runners.spotlight: The neck defeat on good to soft at Bath (1m) offers hope but lesser efforts have followed; needs one of her good days.
runners.comment: The neck defeat on good to soft at Bath (1m) offers hope but lesser efforts have followed

runners.name: Homeland
runners.spotlight: Behind Racing Demon last time but was only 4l away over 1m and his sole win was at this trip; can run well.
runners.comment: Behind Racing Demon latest but was only 4l away over 1m and his sole win was at this trip

runners.name: Ibiza Lights
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in her first handicap but in a first-time visor she only just failed to get up in a 1m2f classified race; if the headgear works again then she should be competitive.
runners.comment: In a first-time visor she only just failed to get up in a 1m2f classified race

runners.name: Madame Passant
runners.spotlight: Better for going handicapping when beaten 4l into third at Chepstow (1m2f, good to firm) and she was keeping on; one of the more appealing options.
runners.comment: Better for going handicapping when beaten 4l into third at Chepstow (1m2f)

runners.name: Gert Lush
runners.spotlight: On a good mark and beaten a neck at Leicester (1m2f, good to firm) two runs back, form that has worked out well; poor last time over an extended 1m3f but that trip seems too far.
runners.comment: Good mark; beaten a neck two runs back and 1m3f again looked too far last time
runners.owner: Mrs Muriel Forward & Dr G C Forward

runners.name: Hammal
runners.spotlight: Has regressed since a half-promising debut and was nowhere in a classified last time.
runners.comment: Has regressed since a half-promising debut and was nowhere in a classified last time

runners.name: Praise Indeed
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced but was slowly away on last month's handicap debut (1m, good) and never counted; work to do with Racing Demon and Homeland on that running.
runners.comment: Slowly away on last month's handicap debut (1m, good) and never counted
runners.owner: Mrs R F Greener And North Farm Stud

runners.name: Prophet Squeeze
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden over jumps and hasn't performed well in 7.5f-1m2f non-handicaps on the Flat.
runners.comment: Modest maiden over jumps and hasn't performed well in 7.5f-1m2f non-handicaps on the Flat

races.race_name: Dandara, Find Your Perfect New Home Handicap

runners.name: Liveinthelight
runners.spotlight: Cost 290,000gns in 2024; edged out Grand Pier with the pair dominant on her handicap debut (1m2f, soft) and then nearly defied a 3lb rise at Nottingham (good to firm); up another 2lb but she'll surely be in the mix, provided she lasts home over this longer trip.
runners.comment: First and second in her two handicaps; up another 2lb but very much in the mix
runners.owner: Lady Bamford , Mrs Collins & Bv Sangster

runners.name: Meet Me In Meraki
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner; first run since March when a rallying third over C&D three weeks ago; thereabouts.
runners.comment: First run since March when a rallying third over C&D three weeks ago; thereabouts
runners.owner: Spiers & Hartwell Ltd & Mrs E Evans

runners.name: Grand Pier
runners.spotlight: Signs of improvement when sixth at Newbury (1m2f, good) and duly built on that with a near miss behind Liveinthelight here over 1m2f (soft), pulling clear of the third; should be fine over this far.
runners.comment: Stayed on well for a near miss over 1m2f here and should be fine over this far

runners.name: Bulldog Spirit
runners.spotlight: On a good mark and knows how to win; however, three of his four runs since a break have been underwhelming.
runners.comment: Capable but three of his four runs since a break have been underwhelming

runners.name: Caelan
runners.spotlight: Has been running well over hurdles and this dual AW winner hasn't had many Flat chances on turf (0-3); on a competitive mark and Hugh Horgan takes off 5lb.
runners.comment: Has been running well over hurdles and he's dual AW winner; competitive mark

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden

runners.name: Celtic Motif
runners.spotlight: Smart maiden for this stable at two, made the frame on all four starts, notably when third in the Goffs Million and fourth (demoted from third) in a 1m fillies' Group 3 event; placed in three of her four starts for Brendan Walsh in the US; has returned to Joseph O'Brien, who fit a tongue-tie; some element of risk attached to her eight-race maiden status, but hard to oppose.
runners.comment: Smart form at two, failed to win during spell in the US, perhaps risky but hard to oppose

runners.name: Capolinea
runners.spotlight: Tenth foal; Harzand filly is a sister to minor 1m2f winner Harseva, half-sister to four winners, including prolific AW scorer Aramis Grey; dam unraced half-sister to high-class miler Intikab; stable in magnificent form with four winners last Saturday
runners.comment: Harzand filly is a sister to minor 1m2f winner, stable in magnificent form last Saturday

runners.name: Taj Crown
runners.spotlight: Ran well in a 1m4f Limerick claimer; well beaten in two maidens since then; takes a sharp drop in distance now; would receive 25lb from Celtic Motif in a handicap.
runners.comment: Ran well in a 1m4f Limerick claimer, well beaten in two maidens since then

runners.name: Acanto
runners.spotlight: Closely related to Australian Group 2 winner Sixties Groove, half-sister to Flat/hurdle winner Smiling Eliza; shaped quite well when fifth behind year-younger rivals on belated debut in a 7f maiden at the Curragh in March; ground was heavy then. may be better suited by a sound surface.
runners.comment: Shaped quite well behind younger rivals on belated debut in a 7f maiden at the Curragh
runners.owner: Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs Wendy O'Leary

runners.name: Rest Your Mind
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to Group 3 winner over 1m6f Raise You and champion bumper performer A Dream To Share; showed some ability for the Kiely stable last season; perhaps more likely a handicap prospect over a bit further.
runners.comment: Well-related, family associated with stamina, possibly a handicap prospect over further

runners.name: Zesty Belle
runners.spotlight: Ran twice at Dundalk last November; will need to get handicap mark.
runners.comment: Ran twice at Dundalk last November, will need to get handicap mark

runners.name: Glittering Gem
runners.spotlight: Favourite for her debut in a 17-runner maiden at the Curragh last September, broke slowly, recovered to challenge before fading late; questions to answer after a disappointing run at Leopardstown in October; heavy ground may have been against her then.
runners.comment: Unplaced favourite on debut, heavy ground may have been against her on second outing

races.race_name: Hotel Killarney Maiden

runners.name: Wild Sapphire
runners.spotlight: Concerning that he has failed to build on his debut second behind two Aidan O'Brien-trained colts in a 7f juvenile maiden at the Curragh; ran only twice last season, and his best effort was when second at Gowran on the first occasion; same pattern this season, fair second at Dundalk before falling to improve at Gowran, perhaps a tongue-tie will make the difference
runners.comment: Best run in three consecutive years has been on seasonal debut, obvious chance but risky

runners.name: Dolly Hello
runners.spotlight: Fairyhouse third (7f, yielding) last September her best effort; unplaced favourite on heavy ground at Galway on her final start last season; official rating of 73 is high enough to put her in the mix in a maiden of this standard.
runners.comment: An official rating of 73 is high enough to put her in the mix in a maiden of this standard

runners.name: Tyraxes
runners.spotlight: First seven runs were on AW, initially for Andrew Balding; placed in three of five Dundalk outings for this stable, including a 3l third over 1m in March; made little impression at Limerick on turf debut; better when fourth over C&D in May; closely matched with Could Dreamer on that running.
runners.comment: Often placed, fourth over C&D in May, closely matched with Coul Dreamer on that running.

runners.name: Coul Dreamer
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler; 0-11 on the Flat, second in a Clonmel maiden last season; best of four runs this term when a staying-on third in a C&D maiden; down the field in a Leopardstown handicap; made a lot of the running before fading into fourth in a maiden over an extended 1m1f at Ballinrobe.
runners.comment: Winning hurdler, 0-11 on the Flat, seems well exposed at this stage, has run well over C&D
runners.owner: Mrs Suzanne McAuley & Ms C A Jennings

runners.name: Sron Na Caise
runners.spotlight: Fair form in maidens at Gowran and Limerick before a disappointing AW run; failed to run up to his handicap mark in an auction maiden at Ballinrobe last time, visored now.
runners.comment: Fair form in maidens at Gowran and Limerick, disappointing since on AW and in a handicap

runners.name: Desert Swing
runners.spotlight: Second foal; gelded son of Make Believe is a brother to Ollie Sangster-trained 1m AW winner Suspicion (RPR 85); dam unraced half-sister to 6f Listed winner Ninjago.
runners.comment: Gelded son of Make Believe is a brother to Ollie Sangster-trained 1m AW winner Suspicion
runners.owner: Sheikh Khalid Bin Ali Al Khalifa

runners.name: Mischievous Fun
runners.spotlight: Has a useful Flat pedigree but no sign of ability; tailed off in an academy hurdle last December; dismal run in bumper at this venue in May; held by Coul Dreamer on Ballinrobe running.
runners.comment: Has a good pedigree but no sign of ability,  held by Coul Dreamer on Ballinrobe running.

runners.name: Medadthebookie
runners.spotlight: Low-rated hurdler; moderate sixth of nine on Flat debut in a 1m5f maiden at Down Royal.
runners.comment: Low-rated hurdler, moderate sixth of nine on Flat debut in a 1m5f maiden at Down Royal

races.race_name: Irish Examiner Handicap

runners.name: Tavarua
runners.spotlight: First of her three runs was her best, form well-advertised by the winner Bobby McGee; down the field at Ballinrobe in her first handicap; a new headgear combination tried.
runners.comment: Down the field at Ballinrobe in her first handicap, new headgear combination tried

runners.name: Wicklow Gap
runners.spotlight: Two less encouraging runs since starting the season brightly with a fourth placing at Roscommon; testing ground probably the issue at Leopardstown; less easy to overlook his Bellewstown failure behind Cause I Like You, Stonyfalls and Beau Army then.
runners.comment: Two less encouraging runs since starting the season brightly with fourth at Roscommon

runners.name: Cause I Like You
runners.spotlight: Has slipped to a basement mark and has begun to show winning potential; stayed on well for second behind an easy winner at Bellewstown; faces a rematch with third-placed Stonyfalls, as well as Beau Army and Wicklow Gap; holds a leading chance.
runners.comment: Stayed on well for second behind an easy winner at Bellewstown, should go close now

runners.name: Stonyfalls
runners.spotlight: Weak form in maidens; 66-1 for handicap debut when sixth of 14 at Down Royal (7f, good), not far behind Beau Army; failed to build on that at the same venue on soft; best run so far when third at Bellewstown 12 days ago; not much between her and Cause I Like You.
runners.comment: Best run so far when third at Bellewstown, not much between her and Cause I Like You

runners.name: Sunrise Angel
runners.spotlight: Narrowly denied on nursery debut at the Curragh last September (7f, yld-sft); again ran well when a close-up fourth at Dundalk in October; flopped on heavy ground on reappearance; struggled again on good ground at Roscommon; questions to answer.
runners.comment: Two disappointing runs this season, could feature if recapturing his best nursery form

runners.name: Wingit
runners.spotlight: Ordinary form in AW handicaps for Gavin Cromwell, much the same at Naas on stable debut; trainer brought off a superb four-timer last Saturday.
runners.comment: Ordinary form in AW handicaps, much the same at Naas on latest, stable in terrific form

runners.name: Beau Army
runners.spotlight: Winner over 6f/7f at Dundalk; ran her best race on turf when fourth behind the progressive Meriden three starts ago; needs to reverse recent Bellewstown form with Cause I Like You and Stonyfalls.
runners.comment: Both wins on AW, needs to reverse Bellewstown form with Cause I Like You and Stonyfalls

runners.name: Ramair
runners.spotlight: Good run at 50-1 when third over 1m on handicap debut at Dundalk in March; has failed to build on that; gelded since his last run.
runners.comment: Good effort on handicap debut at Dundalk in March, has failed to build on that, gelded

runners.name: Zheleznaya Dama
runners.spotlight: Showed ability at two with a third placing in a 7f Down Royal nursery; saddle slipped on her reappearance at Cork; mot beaten far in fifth over a shorter trip at Limerick on Saturday; place possibility with Oisin Murphy up.
runners.comment: Not beaten far over a shorter trip at Limerick on Saturday, place possibility

runners.name: Concaire
runners.spotlight: Good effort at Limerick last month (7f, yielding), losing out by only a nose, despite having raced keenly; suffered interference at a crucial stage when out of the money over the same trip at Down Royal.
runners.comment: Just denied over 7f at Limerick, suffered interference at a crucial stage at Down Royal

runners.name: Sayonara
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability on AW over 5f-6f during the winter; failed to beat a single rival in his two races after being gelded; took a step in the right direction at Limerick on Saturday, though Zheleznaya Dama was in front of him then.
runners.comment: Showed some ability on AW over 5f-6f during the winter, has struggled since being gelded

runners.name: Six Wings
runners.spotlight: Failed to make much impact at Naas on handicap debut; hard to make a case for her, unless this shorter trip suits better.
runners.comment: Failed to make much impact at Naas on handicap debut, shorter trip here may suit better

runners.name: Garryowen Green
runners.spotlight: Modest form in maidens, paid the price for racing too keenly in a 1m1f handicap at Leopardstown last time.
runners.comment: Modest form in maidens, paid the price for racing too keenly in a 1m1f handicap last time

runners.name: De Songbird
runners.spotlight: Not a bad run from a difficult draw at Leopardstown in her first handicap; possibly capable of better.
runners.comment: Not a bad run from a difficult draw at Leopardstown in her first handicap, may do better

races.race_name: Killarney Plaza Hotel & Spa Handicap

runners.name: Elusive Duke
runners.spotlight: 1m1f Leopardstown winner last year for his previous yard; recent seconds at Gowran and Naas have been over longer trips than this; holds a definite chance all the same; Oisin Murphy booked.
runners.comment: Recent seconds have been over longer trips than this, hold a definite chance all the same

runners.name: No More Porter
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been gained at the Curragh; eight of his 17 places have also come at that venue, including a fine second there on his latest start; not guaranteed to produce his best form, though he managed a second placing here in 2023 on his only visit.
runners.comment: Has tended to show his best form at the Curragh, a fine second there on his latest start

runners.name: Mythical Rock
runners.spotlight: Winner on AW in January; unlucky not to finish closer when sixth at Gowran, short of room when travelling well; backed that up with a promising second at Limerick; failed to make his presence felt when a well-supported favourite at Gowran two days later;  the race may have come too soon.
runners.comment: Flopped when favourite at Gowran, that may have come too soon after a good run at Limerick

runners.name: Galley Point
runners.spotlight: Second to a front-running winner in a weak 7f Roscommon contest was his best run last season;  absent since a poor AW effort on handicap debut last November.
runners.comment: Lacks a recent outing, absent since a poor AW effort on handicap debut last November

runners.name: Amemri
runners.spotlight: Has a better strike rate on AW (7-24); however, capable enough on turf (3-24, placed four times) to have a say in a race like this. best of three starts on turf this year when second over 1m at Limerick in April.
runners.comment: Has a better strike rate on AW, capable enough on turf to have a say in a race like this

runners.name: Majestic King
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark in a Gowran handicap over this trip in May and was a close second at Ballinrobe next time; doubts raised by his two most recent outings; beaten favourite for the Curragh race in which No More Porter was second
runners.comment: In good form during April/May, doubts raised by his two most recent outings

runners.name: Red Hugh O'Donnell
runners.spotlight: C&D maiden winner on yielding to soft a year ago; handicap form in unconvincing; in rear at Limerick on seasonal debut in April.
runners.comment: C&D maiden winner on yielding-to-soft a year ago, in rear on seasonal debut in April

runners.name: Tofino
runners.spotlight: Not one of her better efforts at the Curragh last time; hard to win with; best run this season when second in a six-runner contest; others preferred.
runners.comment: Not one of her better efforts at the Curragh last time, hard to win with, others preferred

runners.name: Little Miss P
runners.spotlight: Fair form in maidens last year; disappointing on handicap/seasonal debut at Leopardstown; poor run at Roscommon over an extended 1m2f; better when dropped to 7f at Fairyhouse 13 days ago.
runners.comment: Fair maiden form, best of her three handicap runs when dropped to 7f on latest

runners.name: Spent All Me Money
runners.spotlight: Two wins in 2025, a 7f claiming maiden at Roscommon (good) and a Naas handicap (7f, good); a long way below his best on seasonal debut at Leopardstown in April.
runners.comment: Best form at around 7f, a long way below his best on seasonal debut in April

runners.name: Hexagonal
runners.spotlight: Maiden produced back-to-back solid runs at Ballinrobe and the Curragh earlier this season; has failed to reach the same standard on last three starts, the most recent in a claimer; held by Mythical Rock on Limerick running
runners.comment: Managed two good runs in May, has failed to reach the same standard on last three starts

runners.name: San Aer
runners.spotlight: Four wins to his name, including a C&D maiden success in 2021; last win was in 2023; fair form last year; no encouragement from this term's four starts
runners.comment: Last win was in 2023, fair form last year, no encouragement from this term's four starts

runners.name: Mags
runners.spotlight: Dismal form in four outings (two this season) since winning at Dundalk in November 2024; can be ruled out.
runners.comment: Dismal form in four outings (two this season) since winning at Dundalk in November 2024

runners.name: Marambo
runners.spotlight: Showed enough in three AW maidens last winter to suggest he could pick up a race; tongue-tie and cheekpieces on for turf/seasonal/handicap debut.
runners.comment: Showed enough in three AW maidens last winter to suggest he could pick up a race

runners.name: Usuario Amigo
runners.spotlight: Sole win came in a 7f Brighton maiden in 2024; nothing of note in his form since finishing third of seven at Limerick 12 months ago; in rear in this year's edition of that race on Saturday; has been struggling in handicaps.
runners.comment: In rear in a rated race at Limerick on Saturday, struggling in handicaps this season

races.race_name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap

runners.name: Diamond Exchange
runners.spotlight: Did just about enough to land a Dundalk maiden in January and did similar when following up in a 1m2f handicap at Leopardstown; a little bit more exposed on her two subsequent handicap efforts under a small penalty, but has the ability to get involved here.
runners.comment: A bit more exposed on her two recent efforts but has the ability to get involved here
runners.owner: Bronsan Racing & H Redknapp & John Breslin

runners.name: Jeaniemacaroney
runners.spotlight: Two wins over hurdles for Joseph O'Brien and her sole Flat win was in a Tramore maiden over 1m4f last summer; first run since October having changed stables; market will guide but likely to come on for this.
runners.comment: First run since October having changed stables; market will guide but likely to come on

runners.name: Ankara
runners.spotlight: Dual winner in France with plenty of cut in the ground. First run here for Joseph O'Brien after nine months off; stable could not be in better form, but a watching brief may be the best policy.
runners.comment: First run here for Joseph O'Brien after nine months off; watching brief this time
runners.owner: P J O'Brien & Mrs M V Magnier & Mrs P Shanahan & K Blake

runners.name: Speckled Meadow
runners.spotlight: Good servant to her connections; four-time winner from 7f to 1m2f, but very much at home on much softeer ground than she meets today; up against it taking on some promising fillies with younger legs today.
runners.comment: Very much at home on much softer ground than she meets today; up against it

runners.name: Saga Gaga
runners.spotlight: Showed promise on her Leopardstown debut and followed up with a battling success over 1m1f on easier ground at Gowran; handicapper has not taken many chances with her mark, but there might be more to come over this trip and the homecoming champion jockey is booked.
runners.comment: Handicapper has not taken many chances with her mark but there might be more to come

runners.name: Concert Party
runners.spotlight: Dual winner last year for Richard Hannon; bought to go hurdling but little to recommend in that discipline; best watched on her return to the level.
runners.comment: Bought to go hurdling but little to recommend in that discipline; best watched this time

runners.name: My Girl Grace
runners.spotlight: Soft ground winner on debut over 1m2f at Leopardstown in June; overcame some adversity and showed a good attitude; better ground here, but a promising filly and the handicapper looks to have given her a chance.
runners.comment: Debut winner; a promising filly and the handicapper looks to have given her a chance

runners.name: Spanish Temptress
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner over 1m with ease in the ground on all occasions, including at this meeting last year; handles good ground too; has never tackled a trip this far, but just failed over 1m1f at Gowran and every chance that she will get it; big player if she does.
runners.comment: Four-time winner with an ease, including over 1m here; big player if she gets this trip

runners.name: So Must I
runners.spotlight: Landed a Dundalk maiden early in the year; has found life a little tougher in handicaps since and was out of her depth in Listed company last time; others preferred here.
runners.comment: Found life a little tougher in handicaps and was out of her depth in Listed company latest

races.race_name: Rose Hotel Handicap

runners.name: Gaoth Chuil
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner; travels well in her races and returned to the level in grand style when accounting for the very useful Eagle Fang in a QR contest at Leopardstown; looks a big player here.
runners.comment: Beat the very useful Eagle Fang in a QR contest at Leopardstown; looks a big player here

runners.name: Carthusian
runners.spotlight: Looked a horse of some promise early last season but has failed to progress; coming down the handicap but stepping up to this trip has not improved his record.
runners.comment: Coming down the handicap but stepping up to this trip has not improved his record

runners.name: Satono Chevalier
runners.spotlight: Undergoing very much a new lease of life, winning three of his last four, and a ride of 17lb could still be manageable; unproven over this trip but in the form of his life and will be popular with Oisin Murphy booked.
runners.comment: Unproven over this trip but in the form of his life and will be popular with Oisin Murphy

runners.name: Tribal Star
runners.spotlight: Premier handicap winner over 1m2f at Dundalk last season; upped in trip this year to decent effect; good third in the Chester Plate in May; made no impact in the Northumberland Plate last time but will appreciate the calmer waters here.
runners.comment: No impact in the Northumberland Plate last time but will appreciate the calmer waters here

runners.name: Harry's Legacy
runners.spotlight: Dual winner on the Flat; ran way too bad to bad to be true at Fairyhouse last time but a repeat of his previous effort over this C&D would give him a definite chance here.
runners.comment: A repeat of his effort over C&D in May would give him a definite chance here

runners.name: Individualism
runners.spotlight: Dual winner for Charlie Johnston; fair effort on his stable debut in a maiden hurdle here in May; booking of Billy Lee suggests better is expected today.
runners.comment: Did okay in a maiden hurdle here in May; rider booking suggests better is expected today

runners.name: Persian Bliss
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner on the AW for Adrian Murray; second in a Dundalk claimer for his current yard on his penultimate start; reportedly burst over hurdles at Down Royal last time; others more likely.
runners.comment: Reportedly burst over hurdles at Down Royal last time; others more likely

runners.name: Sign From Above
runners.spotlight: Three wins on the Flat and two over hurdles for this versatile performer; most recently landing a 2m4f handicap hurdle at Gowran in October; ground versatile in the past although might just prefer it a bit softer these days.
runners.comment: Ground versatile in the past although might just prefer it a bit softer these days

races.race_name: Thorn Plant Hire (Q.R.) Maiden

runners.name: Arch Empire
runners.spotlight: Recent efforts over hurdles a little underwhelming but earned a mark of 84 after three good runs in Flat maidens last year, including when third in this race; major player if able to run up to that form.
runners.comment: Third in this race last year; major player if able to run up to that form

runners.name: Eagle Fang
runners.spotlight: Very smart performer; acquitted himself extremely well when second in very valuable handicap hurdles at Aintree and Haydock in the spring; just outpointed by the smart Gaoth Chuil in a similar contest at Leopardstown last month for this rider; the one to beat.
runners.comment: Outpointed in a similar contest at Leopardstown last month for this rider; the one to beat

runners.name: Ma Belle Etoile
runners.spotlight: Won a Cork novice hurdle and a Wexford beginners chase last summer; good run when fifth in a 1m4f Fairyhouse maiden before falling over fences at Wexford two weeks ago; respected.
runners.comment: Good run when fifth in a 1m4f Fairyhouse maiden before falling over fences at Wexford
runners.owner: P Haughey & P M Haughey & John Ball

runners.name: Sunny South West
runners.spotlight: Dual bumper winner and maiden hurdle winner; lightly raced individual and unlikely they have got to the bottom of him yet; back from a five month break, but dangerous if the market gives the right signals.
runners.comment: Back from a five month break but dangerous if the market gives the right signals

runners.name: Path d'Oroux
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner and very useful hurdler/chaser on his day; lost his way last season, but could well play a hand here if he can put it together.
runners.comment: Lost his way last season but could well play a hand here if he can put it together

runners.name: Certamen
runners.spotlight: Has ability; not beaten far in a better contest at Leopardstown last month; each-way possibilities.
runners.comment: Not beaten far in a better contest at Leopardstown last month; each-way possibilities

runners.name: Lauro's Legend
runners.spotlight: Bits and pieces of form; third in a Wexford maiden hurdle last summer and not disgraced at Leopardstown last month; more needed here though.
runners.comment: Not disgraced at Leopardstown last month; more needed here though

runners.name: Ambitious Fellow
runners.spotlight: Bumper and four-time hurdles winner; unraced under Flat rules and comes here on the back of being pulled up in the Connacht National at Roscommon; best watched.
runners.comment: Comes here on the back of being pulled up in the Connacht National; best watched

runners.name: Chain Of Destiny
runners.spotlight: A very infrequent visitor the track; third in a Curragh maiden in 2022 but a mark of 51 fairly reflects his chance.
runners.comment: Third in a Curragh maiden in 2022 but a mark of 51 fairly reflects his chance

runners.name: Double Indian
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in a bumper and two maidens; needs to improve a good deal to be a factor here.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in a bumper and two maidens; needs to improve a good deal to be a factor

runners.name: Jetoile
runners.spotlight: Better chaser than hurdler, as he showed when winning a handicap chase off 120 at Ballinrobe in May; no impact in a 1m4f Tramore maiden since but this longer trip and more conventional track is more likely to suit; could go well.
runners.comment: No impact in a 1m4f Tramore maiden since but this longer trip; could go well

runners.name: Catalani
runners.spotlight: Hunter chase winner at Down Royal in May; well beaten on his first try in a Flat maiden last month; much more needed here.
runners.comment: Well beaten on his first try in a Flat maiden last month; much more needed here

runners.name: Lord Ffrench
runners.spotlight: Stayed well to land a Sligo maiden hurdle last summer; enjoys good ground but might find a couple of these too quick.
runners.comment: Enjoys good ground but might find a couple of these too quick

races.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Ghost Story
runners.spotlight: Lighty raced for her age and made quite promising seasonal debut when third at Lingfield (1m2f) in April but ought to have been well suited by the good to soft turf when below that form at Ffos Las (1m4f; favourite) last month and has a point to prove here.
runners.comment: Had conditions in her favour when well-held third of six on good to soft turf last month

runners.name: Desert Belle
runners.spotlight: Narrowly won 1m4f Southwell novice in April, her second start; yet to build on that performance in two subsequent handicaps but may not have been suited by making her own running on first occasion and would also have preferred a stronger overall pace when third at Kempton last time; has a bigger run in her if/when there is more emphasis on stamina.
runners.comment: Yet to built on her novice win but can do so if/when there is more emphasis on stamina

runners.name: Rose Cotton
runners.spotlight: Made all for clearcut success on handicap debut here (9.4f) in January and came second on both subsequent AW starts (9.4f/1m4f); absent since lesser effort on turf two months ago and her tendency to race too freely is a nagging concern but this return to Tapeta is sure to suit and she remains unexposed over the trip.
runners.comment: Didn't fire on turf last time but earlier AW form makes her a big player
runners.owner: Hasmonean Racing, C Fahy And Marchants

runners.name: Lady Magu
runners.spotlight: Evidently well suited by soft turf when displaying improvement to win 1m2f Ffos Las maiden by nearly 5l last month, her third start; on a different surface here but could still have more to offer over the new trip.
runners.comment: Improved to win 1m2f maiden on soft turf last month; up in trip for handicap debut

runners.name: Sound Janet
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden; left Roger Varian after disappointing run in the autumn and was well beaten on both starts for new stable this spring (1m2f/8.3f; had wind op in between); back up in trip with cheekpieces tried here; big leap of faith required to support her.
runners.comment: Well beaten on both starts for new stable; back up in trip with cheekpieces tried

runners.name: Post Rider
runners.spotlight: Gained all three wins at around 1m on turf; yet to hit top gear after three runs turf this season (1m-1m1f) and moves up in trip with a quite bit to prove.
runners.comment: Gained all three wins at around 1m on turf; yet to hit top gear after three runs this year

runners.name: Guendolen
runners.spotlight: Won in good style on last season's reappearance outing (1m2f, good) but was not in the same form on any of her five subsequent runs last year and was safely held when back in action in April; off for another 75 days since and not yet proven over this far; needs to get career back on track.
runners.comment: Generally disappointing since turf win in spring 2025; needs to get career back on track

runners.name: Shangri La
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who displayed clear promise on all three 2yo starts (1m-8.6f); not obviously well treated for this seasonal/handicap debut but has plenty of scope for improvement over 1m4f.
runners.comment: Unexposed 3yo who showed clear promise on all three 2yo starts; up in trip for h'cap debut

runners.name: Five Moons
runners.spotlight: Safely held when fourth of five in tactical C&D contest on handicap debut in March and not seen since; that defeat is not veiwed that harshly and she may still have potential but others appeal more all the same.
runners.comment: Absent since safely held in tactical C&D contest on handicap debut in April

races.race_name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.name: George Wickham
runners.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival home on his debut at Bath (5.5f, firm) last year but stepped forward from that when a 3l second of eight at Yarmouth (6f, soft; winner has won again since) last month; that was his first start for ten months and he's shortlisted on his AW debut.
runners.comment: Stepped forward from last year's debut when second at Yarmouth (6f, soft); shortlisted

runners.name: Sugar Sugar
runners.spotlight: Looked a difficult ride (pulled hard and hung left) on her debut at Yarmouth (7f, good to soft) last month and again hung left when keeping on into third at Brighton (6f, good to firm) three weeks ago; clearly has ability, but may not be the easiest and stall 12 makes things difficult.
runners.comment: Hung left in both starts but shaped promisingly at Brighton last time; stall 12 a concern

runners.name: Deadline
runners.spotlight: Showed up well for a fair way before fading into sixth on his debut at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last month but proved disappointing at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) 11 days ago; drops in trip and makes his AW debut (out of a Listed winner on the AW) with better needed.
runners.comment: Showed up well for a fair way on his debut but disappointing last time; drops to 6f

runners.name: Honky Tonk Girl
runners.spotlight: Looked green on her debut at Bath (5.5f, good) last month but kept on well to finish fifth off 11 (beaten around 3l); wasn't able to build on that at Southwell (7f, AW) nine days ago but this half-sister to seven winners remains capable of better.
runners.comment: Showed promise on her debut but failed to build on that last time; capable of better

runners.name: Eveninginparis
runners.spotlight: 26,000gns yearling; fifth foal; half-sister to winners Messerschmitt (1m 2yo, 90; useful 2m hurdle) and Goose Rock (5f-1m2f incdluding AW; 67); dam 7f/7.4f 2yo winner (88), out of half-sister to 1m Group 1 winner Nahoodh; needs a close look on her debut.
runners.comment: 26,000gns yearling; half-sister to winners Messerschmitt and Goose Rock

runners.name: Thorpe Green
runners.spotlight: Mayson filly; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Lethimfly (5f 2yo) and Infinity Blue (6f), out of 7f 2yo winning half-sister to HK 1m Group 1 winner Xtension; interesting newcomer.
runners.comment: Dam unraced half-sister to winners Lethimfly (5f 2yo) and Infinity Blue (6f); interesting

runners.name: Coilltedudeisback
runners.spotlight: A'Ali gelding; fourth foal; half-brother to 7.5f/1m2f winner Princess Niyla (RPR 76); dam 9.4f/1m2f AW winner (99), out of unraced half-sister to Group-placed 1m2f winner Tiffany Diamond and 1m2f/1m4f winner Nizamar; market should be informative on his debut.
runners.comment: Half-brother to 7.5f/1m2f winner Princess Niyla (RPR 76); watch the betting on his debut

runners.name: Mimime
runners.spotlight: Out of a 5f AW winner but she's been well beaten in two starts, albeit she wasn't helped by racing wide at Southwell (6f, AW) 26 days ago; others preferred.
runners.comment: Out of a 5f AW winner but well beaten in both starts, including at Southwell last time

runners.name: Good Guys Girl
runners.spotlight: Missed the break and looked in need of the experience on her debut here over 5f four weeks ago, beating only one rival home; steps up in trip and she's open to improvement.
runners.comment: Looked in need of the experience on her debut here over 5f four weeks ago; up in trip
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing & Alfa Site Services

runners.name: Just Dreaming
runners.spotlight: Ran green when fifth of six on her debut at Kempton (5f, AW; 28-1) last April when trained by Mark Usher, failing to settle and hanging left, and has been absent since; best watched unless the market speaks favourably on her yard debut.
runners.comment: Looked green on her debut last April when trained by Mark Usher; makes her yard debut

runners.name: Blazing Gaden
runners.spotlight: Has struggled in each of his seven starts over hurdles (1m7f-2m3f) and has a tricky draw to contend with on his Flat debut; best watched.
runners.comment: Struggled in each of his seven starts over hurdles; best watched on his Flat debut

runners.name: Smooth Flight
