runners.spotlight: Showed little when last of eight on his debut at Lingfield (6f, good; 66-1) last month and now switches to the AW with a big step forward needed.
runners.comment: Showed little when last of eight on his debut and needs to take a big step forward

runners.name: Mariselle
runners.spotlight: Ran well to a point on her debut at Lingfield (6f, good) last month but went backwards from that effort when beating only one rival home at Nottingham (5f, good to firm) ten days ago; likely one for handicaps after one more run.
runners.comment: Went backwards from her debut when beating only one home at Nottingham ten days ago

races.race_name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Handicap

runners.name: Rascal Recknell
runners.spotlight: 2-4 over 7f for this stable last year but made a low-key return over that trip in May and is not sure to be suited by this drop back to 6f.
runners.comment: Made low-key seasonal debut over 7f and is not sure to be suited by this drop back in trip

runners.name: Twilight Fun
runners.spotlight: Five AW wins, the latest from the front off 2lb lower at Newcastle (6f) in February; well below that form on turf lately but still worth keeping an eye on in the betting.
runners.comment: Well below best on turf lately but this five-time AW winner is worth a market check

runners.name: Jumeirah Sands
runners.spotlight: Dual 6f Southwell novice winner this spring and again ran well when keeping-on second on last month's handicap debut at Kempton; could still have more to offer back on Tapeta; high on the list.
runners.comment: Dual 6f Tapeta novice winner this spring and again ran well on handicap debut; big player

runners.name: Manly Fireball
runners.spotlight: Came good at seventh attempt, making all for clearcut success in C&D novice six weeks ago; contests deeper race on this handicap return but is evidently in good nick; no surprise if he features.
runners.comment: Made all in C&D novice last month, opening his account at the seventh attempt

runners.name: Night Storm
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who won twice over 5f on Tapeta (once here) in the autumn and was placed over that trip on handicap debut at Newcastle in January; not quite in same form on turf last month but that run came after a break and he could quite plausibly have untapped potential over 6f back on AW.
runners.comment: Placed over 5f on handicap debut in January; could still have untapped potential over 6f

runners.name: American Style
runners.spotlight: Looked as good as ever when close third of 16 on seasonal debut at Ripon (6f, good to soft) in April but his form has dipped since and he has questions to answer on this AW debut.
runners.comment: Form has dipped since big run on seasonal debut; makes AW debut today

runners.name: Moving Force
runners.spotlight: Belied 50-1 odds when going close at Kempton (6f; AW debut) in May, his second start for Mark Loughnane, but was quickly back in the doldrums (albeit on good to soft ground) on next outing; hard to predict.
runners.comment: Went close at 50-1 odds in May but quickly back in the doldrums last month

runners.name: Aigeas
runners.spotlight: Took form to whole new level when dominating from the front and winning easily at Kempton (6f) 12 days ago, and is now 2-5; hiked up 10lb for that but still commands respect.
runners.comment: Hiked up 10lb for last week's dominant Kempton win but remains lightly raced

runners.name: Rogue Supremacy
runners.spotlight: Managed only fifth of eight at Kempton last month and is now 0-6 for current stable; continues to slip down the weights but his tendency to race too freey remains a concern; swaps cheekpieces for first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: Managed only fifth of eight at Kempton last month and is now 0-6 for current stable

runners.name: Jungle Drums
runners.spotlight: Bettered disappointing seasonal debut when fifth of seven at Goodwood (6f, soft) last month and is now back on same mark as when dead-heating at 80-1 at Chelmsford in the autumn but others have more convincing profiles.
runners.comment: Latest run was a step back in the right direction but others have more convincing profiles
runners.owner: Jim And Claire Ltd And Jon & Kay Collins

runners.name: Charlie Mason
runners.spotlight: Showed career-best form when winning at Lingfield (6f, soft) two starts ago and is also suited by this C&D but could be a shade vulnerable off a mark this high.
runners.comment: Career-best form when winning on soft turf two runs ago; could be on tough mark now

races.race_name: Download The At The Races App Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Wilbur
runners.spotlight: Out of a useful and well-connected 1m 2yo winner; made promising debut when keeping on from the rear for fourth of ten at Newbury (6f, good) in May and subsequent odds-on defeat at Catterick (7f; hampered) can be excused; sets the form standard here and still has significant potential.
runners.comment: Promising fourth on Newbury debut (6f) and subsequent odds-on defeat (7f) excusable

runners.name: Parvenue Star
runners.spotlight: Out of a half-sister to an Australian 1m6f Group 2 winner; never looked dangerous when midfield in 13-runner Newbury maiden (6f, good to firm) 12 days ago but that still goes down as an encouraging debut and she can improve over this longer trip.
runners.comment: Never dangerous when midfield on Newbury debut but that was still quite promising

runners.name: Best Yet
runners.spotlight: 14th foal; sister to 7f AW winner Beta Reader (RPR 66), half-sister to four winners including Bedale (1m2f; 107), Big Meeting (1m/1m2f AW; 100) and Ex Gratia (6f AW; 84); dam 5f and 5.5f (Listed) 2yo winner (102), half-sister to Arc winner Bago; well worth a glance in the betting.
runners.comment: Out of a Listed 2yo winner and half-sister to Arc winner Bago; market check recommended

runners.name: Costa Verde
runners.spotlight: 525,000gns yearling; first foal; dam ran twice at 7f (RPR 47), half-sister to winners Royal Champion (KSA 10.5f Group 1) and Outbox (1m4f Group 2), out of 1m4f Group 2 winning half-sister to 7f/1m Group 1 winner Dubawi; with that price-tag and pedigree, she's a newcomer to take very seriously.
runners.comment: Well-bred filly who cost 525,000gns as a yearling; must be considered

runners.name: Charlemont GG
runners.spotlight: 130,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; third foal; half-brother to winners Sun Never Sets (Group-placed 7.7f-1m3f; RPR 106) and Proletariat (US Graded stakes-placed 5f/6f turf including 2yo); dam Spanish 1m/US 1m1f winner (103); interesting pedigree, but it's unnerving to spot headgear on a newcomer.
runners.comment: Interesting pedigree, but it's unnerving to spot headgear on a newcomer

runners.name: La Fuerza
runners.spotlight: Out of a French Listed-placed 7f winner; bettered low-key debut when respectable third of six at Pontefract (6f, good) last month and has possibilities if he makes any further progress over this longer trip.
runners.comment: Respectable third of six at Pontefract (6f) last month; open to more progress over 7f

runners.name: High Calibre
runners.spotlight: Flopped when warm favourite for Brighton debut in May and showed only minor promise when sixth of seven at Ffos Las (also 6f) a fortnight ago; up in trip for AW debut; improvement required.
runners.comment: Flopped when favourite on debut and showed only minor promise on second start (also 6f)

runners.name: Martinet
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; dam 1m-1m4f winner (including 2yo/Group 1; RPR 117), half-sister to winners Midas Touch (1m2f Group 2; runner-up in St Leger and Irish Derby) and Streetcar To Stars (useful 1m2f); stable has only occasional first-time-out 2yo winners but this filly has an excellent pedigree.
runners.comment: Stable has only occasional first-time-out 2yo winners but this filly has striking pedigree

runners.name: Waakabb
runners.spotlight: 175,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; third foal; dam unplaced 1m2f turf/1m3f AW (RPR 51), closely related to 1m Listed winner Mooharib, half-sister to 1m2f Listed winner Trethias, out of maiden half-sister to 1m2f/1m4f Group 1 winner Dar Re Mi; with respected stable; no surprise if he features on debut.
runners.comment: 175,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; out of a well-connected mare and represents a good stable

runners.name: Hey Dude
runners.spotlight: Out of a half-sister to triple 5f Group 1 winner Bradsell but always behind when 50-1 for debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; remains best watched.
runners.comment: Always behind when 50-1 for debut at Windsor (6f) a fortnight ago; remains best watched

runners.name: Minzaal Time
runners.spotlight: Well down the field on both starts (6f/7f); needs to take a big step forward.
runners.comment: Well down the field on both starts (6f/7f); needs to take a big step forward

runners.name: Royal Titan
runners.spotlight: £62,000 (breeze-up) 2yo; raced too freely and finished last of nine when 16-1 for recent debut at Lingfield (7f, AW).
runners.comment: Raced too freely and finished last of nine when 16-1 for recent Lingfield debut (7f, AW)

races.race_name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div I)

runners.name: Adelaide Bay
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner on the AW in 2025; back in good form after three competitive runs over 7f and quite appealing.
runners.comment: Back in good form after three competitive runs over 7f and has a big run in him

runners.name: On Key
runners.spotlight: No wins in 23 but has been banging at the door in recent months and won't mind returning to 7f.
runners.comment: Has been banging at the door in recent months and won't mind returning to 7f

runners.name: Fistral Beach
runners.spotlight: Only seventh over C&D last time but she's usually reliable here and was a winner in March; nothing wrong with her mark.
runners.comment: Only seventh over C&D last time but she's usually reliable here and was a winner in March

runners.name: Sanditon
runners.spotlight: Both his wins have come on AW, the latest here in June off 5lb lower; current mark will be no excuse and a greater concern would be his last run at Musselburgh.
runners.comment: Current mark will be no excuse and a greater concern would be his last run at Musselburgh

runners.name: Twitch
runners.spotlight: Not well drawn for one who likes to race prominently and last two runs have been underwhelming; others safer.
runners.comment: Not well drawn for one who likes to race prominently; last two runs underwhelming
runners.owner: The Limes Of Epsom Racing Club

runners.name: Midnight's Dream
runners.spotlight: Dual winner for Roger Varian (7f/1m; AW/good to firm); has slipped to a good mark and he halted the slide in his fortunes with a third at Yarmouth; considered despite an awkward draw.
runners.comment: Slipped to a good mark and he halted the slide in his fortunes with a third at Yarmouth

runners.name: Tommy McJohn
runners.spotlight: Close third at Dundalk (5f, Polytrack) in January on final Irish start; his debut for this one was promising but well beaten since; now 1-18.
runners.comment: His debut for this yard was promising but well beaten since; now 1-18

runners.name: Em Jay Kay
runners.spotlight: Current wellbeing is an issue as he's performed poorly since his win in January; best known for sprinting exploits.
runners.comment: Current wellbeing is an issue as he's performed poorly since his win in January

runners.name: Dancing With Drums
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner over 6f; yet to offer much over this far (0-5) and hasn't beaten a rival in his last two races.
runners.comment: Three-time AW winner over 6f; yet to offer much over this far (0-5)

runners.name: Quite Sweet
runners.spotlight: Won over 1m at Southwell in October (1m AW; 5lb lower) but not many positives to draw on since that win; off since January.
runners.comment: Southwell winner in October but not many positives to draw on since that win

runners.name: Blackjack
runners.spotlight: Has won on turf but better on the AW and may have needed it at Wetherby last time after a break (and wind surgery); perhaps more effective at 6f, though.
runners.comment: Has won on turf but better on the AW, though 6f seems more his trip

races.race_name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Handicap (Div II)

runners.name: Classy Clarets
runners.spotlight: Arrives seeking a hat-trick after 7f turf wins at Musselburgh (good) and Catterick (good to firm), the latter with ease and his best effort for almost two years; still well treated on this first AW start since March and a repeat of either of his last two efforts would make him tough to beat.
runners.comment: Seeking a hat-trick after back-to-back 7f turf wins; still well treated; tough to beat.

runners.name: Homme De Fer
runners.spotlight: C&D winner when 7lb lower last December; reasonably consistent in five starts since scoring at Lingfield; tongue-tie now tried; each-way player but looks in need of a favour from the handicapper before winning again.
runners.comment: C&D winner; each-way player but looks in need of a favour from the handicapper.

runners.name: Dayman
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who is without success in over four years; went close over C&D in March when 3lb higher but needs to bounce back after being well beaten (6f, good to soft; first-time blinkers) at Chepstow latest.
runners.comment: C&D winner on a handy mark but needs to bounce back after lacklustre effort at Chepstow.

runners.name: Whitesnake
runners.spotlight: Moderate form in her three qualifying starts but improved on entering this sphere at Chepstow (6f, good) latest, when she raced prominently but didn't quite have the pace late on; the step up in trip looks positive for her first start on Tapeta; drops 2lb; not ruled out.
runners.comment: Step up in trip looks positive for her first start on Tapeta; drops 2lb; not ruled out.

runners.name: Macedonian
runners.spotlight: 6f Polytrack winner; on the slide in the handicap for some time; drops again in grade for this first start at the track; has shown he acts on Tapeta at Newcastle and is on a very handy mark in relation to the form he showed there last October; blinkers go on; remains unproven over this trip.
runners.comment: 6f Polytrack winner; drops in grade and is on a handy mark; unproven over 7f; blinkers on.

runners.name: Victory Sound
runners.spotlight: 7f turf winner (good to firm) when with Charles Hills; 0-9 for current trainer but his last two efforts have offered more encouragement; each-way player.
runners.comment: 0-9 for this yard but last two efforts have offered more encouragement; each-way player.

runners.name: Cooramook
runners.spotlight: 19-race maiden who wasn't too far off her best when under 2l second over C&D latest; appears to lack gears at the business end of her races but that recent form suggests she'll be an each-way player.
runners.comment: 0-19; under 2l second over C&D latest; lacks gears but remains an each-way player.

runners.name: Makes Me Wonder
runners.spotlight: 1m turf winner (good) who arrives with a bit to prove over this trip; drops 1lb after his latest 4l fourth at Yarmouth (1m, good to soft); unplaced from six attempts on AW surfaces; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: 1m turf winner who is unplaced from six attempts on AW surfaces; others make more appeal.

runners.name: Beaming Light
runners.spotlight: 1m turf winner (soft/good to firm) who is 1-16 on AW (won over 1m on Polytrack); unexposed over 7f but to have a serious chance he'll need to raise the bar based on his last four starts.
runners.comment: Unexposed over 7f but needs to raise the bar to have a serious chance.

races.race_name: Follow @attheraces On X Handicap

runners.name: Educate
runners.spotlight: C&D winner last April off a mark 2lb higher than today's; travelled well but didn't see things out as well as the first two when third at Redcar (1m6f, good; first-time visor) last month and has solid claims returned to the AW.
runners.comment: C&D winner last April; solid third over 1m6f on turf last time and has claims back on AW

runners.name: Nala The Lioness
runners.spotlight: Showed the benefit of a wind operation when winning a classified event at Windsor (1m4f, good to soft) last month and backed that up with a good second behind an in-form rival at Ayr (1m5f, soft); acts on the AW and she makes the shortlist on this return to handicap company.
runners.comment: Has won and finished second since undergoing wind surgery; shortlisted back in a handicap

runners.name: Wonderful Wendy
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced filly who stepped up on her previous efforts when second of nine at Chepstow (1m4f, soft) on her handicap debut last month; looks capable of building on that now switched back to the AW.
runners.comment: Lightly raced filly who ran well when second at Chepstow on her handicap debut; back on AW

runners.name: Blue Tulip
runners.spotlight: Well held in each of her three starts in novice/maiden company (1m/1m2f) but she's well related and may yet do better now stepping up in trip on her handicap debut; makes some appeal.
runners.comment: Well held in each of her three starts (1m/1m2f) but may yet do better now handicapping

runners.name: Luan
runners.spotlight: Posted an improved effort when getting off the mark at the sixth attempt at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) 18 days ago, beating a subsequent winner; a 4lb rise looks fair and he's open to further progress, albeit he does have his stamina to prove for this longer trip.
runners.comment: Off the mark the sixth attempt when winning over 1m2f at Newcastle; 4lb rise looks fair

runners.name: Late Claim
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 16 starts came on her handicap debut at Lingfield (1m5f, AW) in December; runner-up on three occasions since, twice over this C&D, but she's been behind Nala The Lioness on her last two starts.
runners.comment: Won on her h'cap debut at Lingfield in December; behind Nala The Lioness on last two runs

runners.name: Roman Secret
runners.spotlight: Overcame a wide trip when narrowly winning here over 9.5f in April and posted another good effort when third of 11 here last month; has since left Kevin and Lauren Frost and steps back up in trip, which is a concern, on her stable debut.
runners.comment: Both wins have been at this track over shorter (8.5f/9.5f); trip a concern on yard debut
runners.owner: Dr M Voikhansky & Mrs S Voikhanskaya

runners.name: Galistra
runners.spotlight: Beat just one rival home in each of her two starts on the AW for Ralph Beckett (1m3f/1m4f) and she was beaten 16l when last of five at Thirsk (1m4f, good; wind surgery) on her stable debut four weeks ago; much better needed on her handicap debut.
runners.comment: Well beaten in each of her three starts, including on stable debut; much better needed

runners.name: Virtual Hug
runners.spotlight: Four of his six wins have been at this track (three over C&D) but his most recent success came at Bath (1m4f, good) in May; two respectable efforts there since and now has cheekpieces back on for the first time in nearly three years; place claims.
runners.comment: Four-time course winner (three over C&D); has been running well and holds place claims
runners.owner: Mike Harris Racing & Nikki Evans Racing

runners.name: A Daughters Love
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish filly who has been in good form since stepping up in trip, winning at Chepstow (1m2f, good to firm) before following up at Leicester (1m2f, good to firm) ten days ago; up 3lb for that latest success but she leaves the impression this trip will suit and could well complete the hat-trick.
runners.comment: Has been in good form since stepping up to 1m2f; could well complete the hat-trick

runners.name: Come On John
runners.spotlight: Three-time course winner, the most recent coming last March over this trip when trained by James Owen; 0-6 since joining this stable and he was well beaten in a classified event at Newcastle last month.
runners.comment: Three-time course winner; 0-6 since joining this yard and well beaten at Newcastle latest

runners.name: Crazy Plan
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two starts last year at around 1m and it was the same story on her reappearance at Leicester (1m2f, good to firm) in May; dam won over 1m4f and she now steps up in trip for her handicap debut.
runners.comment: Well beaten in three starts (1m-1m2f) but now makes her handicap debut; dam won over 1m4f

races.race_name: Cygames Prix de Malleret (Group 2) (Fillies) (Turf)

runners.name: Pink Panthera
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m1f110yd Listed event at Bordeaux Le Bouscat in May on good to soft, but was behind Behrayna and Zlata here over 1m3f on very soft before that; took a major step forward last time, though, when finishing a short-neck runner-up in the Prix de Diane (1m2f110yds, good to firm); anything like that sort of level of performance would make her a big player back up in trip, with Pierre-Charles Boudot on for the first time.
runners.comment: Career best when runner-up in the Prix de Diane last time; needs to back that up

runners.name: Behrayna
runners.spotlight: Yet to be beaten and stepped up in trip on every run since her debut in April, beating Zlata the last two times, most recently in a 1m4f Group 3 at Chantilly on good ground; also in front of Pink Panthera before than when winning a 1m3f Listed event here; sure to have more to come and has strong claims.
runners.comment: Yet to be beaten and stays this trip well; sure to have more to come and has strong claims

runners.name: Proxima Du Centaur
runners.spotlight: Finished over 4l behind Behrayna two runs back when fourth of six and then a shade over 5l behind Dispatches 37 days ago, both races coming here; Ryan Moore an interesting jockey booking on first at over 1m4f but others far easier to make cases for.
runners.comment: Behind some of these recently; tough task up in trip but Ryan Moore aboard

runners.name: Dispatches
runners.spotlight: Debut fifth has been followed by three wins, the most recent her career best when landing a 1m2f Listed event here on good to soft, when Proxima Du Centaur was fourth; needs to step up again but unexposed and should improve; first time Colin Keane rides.
runners.comment: Unbeaten since her debut fifth; needs more but can improve

runners.name: Zlata
runners.spotlight: Won on her debut over a mile on soft in September and shown steady progression this campaign, although she has been about 2l behind Behrayna on her two most recent runs; stays this trip fine but will need to up her game a bit to get the better of the Francis Graffard filly this time.
runners.comment: Steadily progression this campaign but behind Behrayna on her two most recent runs

races.race_name: Cygames Grand Prix de Paris (Group 1) (No Geldings) (Turf)

runners.name: Maltese Cross
runners.spotlight: Typical Haggas improver who followed his narrow win in the Lingfield Derby Trial with a fine second to Christmas Day in a soft-ground Derby; no issues with the return to a sounder surface and been given plenty of time to get over those exertions; big chance.
runners.comment: Improver; won the Lingfield Derby Trial before finishing second in the Derby; big chance

runners.name: Causeway
runners.spotlight: Fourth to Derby winner Christmas Day on his debut but has won his other five starts, with his best effort in refitted cheekpieces when beating Ancient Egypt in a Group 2 at Royal Ascot; decent claims for a trainer who is bidding to win this a sixth time.
runners.comment: Best effort in refitted cheekpieces when winning a Group 2 at Royal Ascot; claims
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: Alam
runners.spotlight: Mostly progressive; followed Group 3 win at Saint-Cloud with a creditable fifth to subsequent Eclipse winner Constitution River in the Jockey Club; shapes as though the step up to this trip will be in his favour - backed up by pedigree - and he'll likely give a good account.
runners.comment: Best effort when fifth in the Prix du Jockey Club; well worth a try over 1m4f; player

runners.name: Limestone
runners.spotlight: Improving sort whose best effort came when winning the Queen's Vase, form which was franked at Newmarket last week,; down in trip and up in grade, so more needed if he's to take the winning run to five.
runners.comment: Progressing nicely and best effort to win the Queen's Vase; more needed down in trip

runners.name: Ancient Egypt
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on soft ground in the Derby but that run flanked by Listed win at Newmarket and a fine second to Causeway (pair a long way clear) in the Group 2 King Edward VII at Royal Ascot; bit more needed but will likely get the run of the race and could go well.
runners.comment: Turned in a pb when second in a Group 2 at Royal Ascot last month; could get easy lead

runners.name: Varandir
runners.spotlight: Arc entry who is unbeaten in three starts and turned in best effort when taking the Group 3 Hocquart over 1m3f at this venue in May; this will likely be the quickest ground he's tackled and more needed again in grade but he's a fascinating runner.
runners.comment: Won all three starts, including a Group 3 here last time; more needed but can't rule out

runners.name: Space Waltz
runners.spotlight: Record is one of steady improvement and he turned in his best effort when winning a Group 3 over this trip on quick ground at Chantilly last time; Andre Fabre has won this a record 14 times but more needed to win going up to this grade for the first time.
runners.comment: Steady improver who turned in his best effort at Chantilly last time; more needed

races.race_name: Radio FG - Prix Maurice de Nieuil (Group 2) (Turf)

runners.name: Double Major
runners.spotlight: Won this in 2024 and a two-time Group 1 winner over 1m7.5f; generally a reliable performer as a stayer and enjoying another good season, his sixth in the Group 1 Prix Vicomtesse Vigier last time not far off his best, so solid chance if running his race.
runners.comment: Won this in 2024 and a two-time Group 1 winner over 1m7.5f; solid chance

runners.name: Espoir Avenir
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m7f Group 3 here last August on very soft, but not added to that win since, although run plenty of good races over a range of distances, albeit nearly 3l behind Sons And Lovers (getting 2lb) in Saudi Arabia in February; going back up in trip should be a positive and will be thereabouts if producing his best.
runners.comment: Been a few runs since he last won but usually runs his race and step up in trip suits

runners.name: Parachutiste
runners.spotlight: Displayed plenty of smart form as a 3yo, winning three times, including a 1m4f Listed event, and performing creditably in Group races; shaped okay on only run over a staying trip following a gelding operation over the winter on soft ground and comes into this off a career best, achieved at 1m4f; unexposed at the distance and one of the more interesting ones.
runners.comment: Unexposed at this distance and heads into this after career best over 1m4f; interesting
runners.owner: Qatar Racing Ltd, Ecurie Skymarc Farm & Ecurie Des Monceaux

runners.name: Sons And Lovers
runners.spotlight: Won the Group 2 Red Sea Turf (1m7f, good to firm) earlier in the year and followed that with some solid efforts until recording a career best in the 1m4f Hardwicke Stakes last month when cheekpieces were tried; going back up in trip will suit and tongue-tie goes on, so only issue is the 3lb he has to give away to all rivals.
runners.comment: Stays well and comes into this off a career best; has to give away 3lb, though

runners.name: Barbate
runners.spotlight: Improving stayer who heads into this searching for a five-timer having won a 1m7f Listed race at Saint-Cloud recently on good ground; no telling where his improvement will take him but does need more up against some proven Group performers on first start in this company.
runners.comment: Heads into this searching for a five-timer, but more needed in Group company

runners.name: Waldadler
runners.spotlight: Sent off 33-1 when fifth of six in the race 12 months ago (Double Major third), the only other time Cristian Demuro rode, and run creditably at times since; matched his career best two runs ago but, on balance, has something to find being more exposed than some.
runners.comment: Sent off 33-1 when fifth of six in the race 12 months ago; needs more
